prompt: Add a toast notification component to the frontend. Create a showToast(message, type) function in public/app.js where type can be 'success', 'error', or 'info'. Style the toasts in public/style.css to appear in the top-right corner, auto-dismiss after 3 seconds, and have different colors for each type.

assertions.name: supports_types
assertions.description: Function handles success, error, and info types
